content:
Co-founder of Lost Souls Paranormal Investigations Beth Mortas says the veil between the living and the dead is the thinnest on Halloween Eve, and expects to pick up on a significant amount of activity at the event.

CORTLAND, NY (607NewsNow) — From 7:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. on October 30th, Lost Souls Paranormal Investigations will lead participants through an investigation at the museum.

The group, made up of professional paranormal investigators, primarily travel around the northeastern United States looking to communicate with those beyond the veil at sites that are rumored to exhibit paranormal activity.

Using equipment such as flashlights, EMF readers, REM pods, and more to receive signs of paranormal activity, the group has held multiple investigations at the 1890 House Museum previously. Co-founder of Lost Souls Paranormal Investigations Beth Mortas says the veil between the living and the dead is the thinnest on Halloween Eve, and expects to pick up on a significant amount of activity at the event.

Tickets are $50 per person, doors open for the event at 6:30 p.m. Find tickets for the investigation on the 1890 House Museum website here, and learn more about Lost Souls Paranormal on their Facebook page here.
